title: Skill: verification ticks commit their evidence (RESULT-<id>.md) even with no source change
description:
A verification/measurement tick often changes no source. Runners collect an attempt by its branch commits: ticfac's collect refuses an attempt with no commits (verdict no-commits), and observed verification workers left RESULT-<id>.md uncommitted and were refused. The skill mentions RESULT-<tick>.md only under tk cloud wait.

Change: in tick-patterns.md (and the implementer guidance in agent-runner.md), state that a verification tick's acceptance says the evidence file is committed, and that a no-source-change attempt still commits its evidence.
acceptance_criteria: tick-patterns.md has a verification-tick pattern whose acceptance requires the committed evidence file; agent-runner.md implementer guidance says evidence output is committed even with no source change
closed_reason: Verification Tick pattern in tick-patterns; agent-runner implementer step commits evidence even with no source change
